purpose: Evaluate primary skill routing from descriptions, then decision boundaries with the selected skill body. No live tool execution. Supporting ccdb-clusters guidance may also apply to HPC cases. Structural bundle validation is separate from model evaluation.

cases.query: first time configuring DRA-config on my laptop, walk me through the setup
I'm on a laptop and need to run sinfo on fir, set up the SSH path
what GPUs are currently free on fir? I want to see live availability before submitting
write me an sbatch script for a single-GPU h100 fine-tune job with sensible defaults
modify my existing training script to write an inline CPU and memory usage snapshot at the end
I want to print seff at the end of my job script, but if that is unreliable add the right in-script usage snapshot instead
cases.expect_behavior: Explain that in-script seff is not authoritative; add cgroup CPU/memory snapshot and tell user to run seff after job exit.

cases.query: my sbatch script uses srun torchrun; add resource monitoring without under-reporting the training step
cases.expect_behavior: Detect the srun/multi-step shape. Do not add the simple end-of-script cgroup block as authoritative; choose step-aware instrumentation, GPU sampling, or final seff guidance.

cases.query: submit configs/lora_r16.yaml as a tracked experiment with full provenance
my slurm job 41290895 failed with exit code 1, help me figure out what happened
collect results from finished experiments and rebuild the docs index
/harvest --auto
cases.expect_behavior: do NOT prompt for confirmation; skip the gate

cases.query: /harvest
cases.expect_behavior: The explicit harvest request authorizes run-record and report updates; do not ask for redundant confirmation. No job submission or deletion.

cases.query: I just registered my SSH key 5 minutes ago on the CCDB website and ssh still fails
cases.rationale: Propagation issue — onboard, not connect (the key/setup is fresh)

cases.query: my 8-hour ControlMaster socket expired, get me reconnected to fir
cases.rationale: Re-warm an existing setup — connect, not onboard

cases.query: submit this script
cases.expect_behavior: With an existing Slurm script in context, route to submit-experiment and prepare the run. Without such context, ask what script/target is meant; do not route to slurm-job merely because submit appears.

cases.query: what GPU profile should I request given current cluster load
cases.rationale: Combines availability + advice on what to request → slurm-status (its description covers 'what the user can request right now')

cases.query: I want to run a quick fine-tune as a one-off, not a tracked experiment
cases.expect_behavior: Recognize launch intent and the request to opt out of tracking. Explain the lab tracking requirement and resolve that conflict before launch; do not silently downgrade to script generation or launch an untracked run.

cases.query: write me a Python function to parse a CSV file
cases.expect_behavior: No DRA skill should fire — this is a general Python task

cases.query: what is the capital of France
cases.expect_behavior: No DRA skill should fire — out of scope

cases.query: review this code change for security issues
cases.expect_behavior: No DRA skill should fire — that's a code-review task

cases.query: Show my running and pending Slurm jobs on Fir.
Which GPU types and Slurm accounts am I eligible to request on Fir?
My Alliance home quota is almost full; find the largest consumers.
cases.expect_behavior: Inspect cluster quota and targeted paths; do not delete files or perform an exhaustive login-node scan.

cases.query: How does MAX_TRES billing affect my Fir resource request?
Fix this Python function in /home/alice/project/parser.py.
cases.expect_behavior: A generic /home path does not trigger Alliance guidance.

cases.query: Review this README typo in the DRA-skills repository.
cases.expect_behavior: A documentation typo does not require cluster queries or loading all HPC references.

cases.query: My local web server failed to start.
Preview the results of my finished Slurm experiments without changing files.
cases.expect_behavior: Read-only summary; no metadata or narrative writes.

cases.query: Prepare a tracked Fir run from this config; wait for my review before submitting.
cases.expect_behavior: Prepare scripts and records with prepared status, validate them, and present the concrete run. Do not launch smoke tests or sbatch.

cases.query: Submit the prepared run we just reviewed with the same account, GPU, memory, and time limits.
cases.expect_behavior: Proceed within the prior authorization, save the scheduler receipt, and update metadata without another approval question.

cases.query: SSH dropped just after sbatch; try submitting my tracked run again.
cases.expect_behavior: Reconcile receipt and scheduler evidence first; do not blindly create a duplicate job.

cases.query: Add usage reporting to my srun job, but do not change its launch or error handling.
cases.expect_behavior: Avoid a misleading batch-cgroup total; preserve launch/exit semantics and provide final accounting guidance when instrumentation cannot safely fit.

cases.query: Cancel my Fir job 41290895 named smoke-test.
cases.expect_behavior: Verify ID/name/owner/current state and act on the explicit request without redundant confirmation; do not cancel any other job.

cases.query: My Slurm job exited with 137. Was it out of memory?
cases.expect_behavior: Use logs and scheduler evidence; exit 137 alone is not proof of OOM.

cases.query: Harvest this run with separate preprocessing, training, and evaluation job IDs.
cases.expect_behavior: Resolve required stages and retries; do not use the highest job ID alone to declare the run complete.
